actions.title: Check the device answers
actions.description: Answers at once; used by Test connection.

actions.title: Read device details
actions.description: The device's OS, app version, battery and network.

actions.title: Take a screenshot
actions.description: Captures the screen, or one window.

window.description: Window title to capture; the whole screen when empty

file.description: Id of a file the device uploaded

actions.title: Show a notification
actions.description: Shows a notification on the device.

actions.title: Ask the person on the device
actions.description: Shows a question with buttons and returns the one pressed.

actions.title: List a folder
actions.description: Lists files in a folder the person allowed.

actions.title: Read a file
actions.description: Reads a file in an allowed folder, as text or as an uploaded file.

file.description: Id of a file the device uploaded

actions.title: Write a file
actions.description: Writes text or a Jizza file into an allowed folder.

actions.title: Move or rename a file
actions.description: Moves a file inside the allowed folders.

actions.title: Open a page
actions.description: Opens a page in the Jizza browser profile.

actions.title: Click on a page
actions.description: Clicks an element, found by its label, role or CSS selector.

actions.title: Type on a page
actions.description: Types into a field. A saved login is named by secretRef; the password never leaves the device.

actions.title: Read text or a table from a page
actions.description: Reads an element's text, a list or a table.

actions.title: Download a file
actions.description: Downloads a file from a page and uploads it to Jizza.

file.description: Id of a file the device uploaded

actions.title: Open URL
actions.description: Opens an HTTP or HTTPS URL in a browser session.

actions.title: Click element
actions.description: Clicks a located page element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Hover over element
actions.description: Moves the pointer over a located page element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Set text
actions.description: Sets the value of a text field, optionally from a saved login.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Get text
actions.description: Reads text, value, or an attribute from an element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Set checkbox
actions.description: Checks, unchecks, or toggles a checkbox.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Get checkbox state
actions.description: Reads whether a checkbox is checked.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Select item
actions.description: Selects one or more items in a list or select control.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Extract table data
actions.description: Reads rows and columns from a table, including paginated tables.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Select radio button
actions.description: Selects a radio button directly or within a group.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Get radio state
actions.description: Reads a radio button or radio group's current state.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Scroll page
actions.description: Scrolls the page, an element, or until another element appears.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Send hotkeys
actions.description: Sends one or more keyboard keys, optionally to an element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Type into element
actions.description: Types into a field with optional per-key delay.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Check element exists
actions.description: Checks whether a located element exists and is visible.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Switch browser context
actions.description: Switches to a tab, window, or frame.

actions.title: Refresh page
actions.description: Refreshes the current page.

actions.title: Get element selectors
actions.description: Builds robust selectors for an element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Get web page details
actions.description: Returns requested details and files for the current page.

actions.title: Go forward
actions.description: Moves forward in browser history.

actions.title: Go back
actions.description: Moves back in browser history.

actions.title: Close browser
actions.description: Closes the current tab, session, or browser.

actions.title: Wait
actions.description: Waits for time, page state, or an element.

text.description: For text and textGone: the text to wait for.

urlContains.description: For url: part of the page address to wait for.

actions.title: Take browser screenshot
actions.description: Captures the page or a located element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Pick element
actions.description: Lets the person choose an element while designing a workflow.

actions.title: Record browser actions
actions.description: Records browser actions while designing a workflow.

actions.title: Handle pop-up dialogs
actions.description: Answers the page's alert, confirm and prompt dialogs until it navigates, so a step that opens one does not wait for a person.

answer.description: accept = OK, dismiss = Cancel, off = let the page show its own dialogs again.

promptText.description: What to type into a prompt dialog when accepting.

times.description: Answer every dialog until the page changes, or only the next one.

actions.title: Drag and drop
actions.description: Drags a located element onto another element in the same frame.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Run web steps together
actions.description: Runs several web steps in one command, in order, stopping at the first that fails. Used for fast replay; each step is judged by the guardrails on its own before it is sent.

actions.title: Set date
actions.description: Fills a date, time, or date and time field. Takes dates such as 2026-11-09, 09 Nov 2026, or 2026-11-09 18:30.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

value.description: The date (and time). Map it from earlier steps to fill it at run time.

format.description: Only for a plain text field: how the site writes dates, such as DD/MM/YYYY or DD MMM YYYY, HH:mm. Date pickers built into the browser need none.

actions.title: Check items
actions.description: Ticks the checkboxes of a group whose labels are listed, such as several interests or seats. Locate the group or any checkbox in it.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

items.description: Labels (or values) of the boxes to tick. Map a list, or comma-separated text, from earlier steps.

only.description: Untick the boxes in the group that are not listed.

actions.title: List items
actions.description: Reads the cards or rows of a list, such as the movies on a booking page, from one item of it.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Choose from a list
actions.description: Clicks the card or row of a list whose text matches, such as a movie or a date, finding the list as it is when the step runs.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

item.description: Which item to click: its text, such as a movie name, or its position with by index. Map it to choose at run time.

actions.title: Fill form
actions.description: Fills several fields of a form in one step: text, text areas, dropdowns, checkboxes, checkbox groups, radio buttons and dates, each from a value or from earlier steps.

highlight.description: Outline each field on the page before filling it.

value.description: Text, a choice, true or false for a checkbox, or a list for a checkbox group.

actions.title: Run a recorded browser task
actions.description: Deprecated: Replays steps recorded once in the Jizza Agent app.

actions.title: Open an app
actions.description: Starts or focuses a desktop app.

actions.title: Click in an app
actions.description: Clicks a control in an app window, found by its accessibility name.

actions.title: Type in an app
actions.description: Types into a control in an app window.

actions.title: Read an app window
actions.description: Reads the text of a window or one control.

actions.title: Press keys in an app
actions.description: Presses keys or shortcuts in an app window, such as Enter, Tab or Ctrl+S. Keys use SendKeys notation: {ENTER}, {TAB}, ^s for Ctrl+S, %f for Alt+F.

actions.title: Record app actions
actions.description: Records clicks, typing and shortcuts in Windows apps while a person shows a task, for review and saving as a workflow.

actions.title: Read a spreadsheet
actions.description: Reads rows from an Excel or CSV file in an allowed folder.

actions.title: Write to a spreadsheet
actions.description: Writes rows into an Excel or CSV file in an allowed folder.

actions.title: Get the phone's location
actions.description: Asks the phone where it is.

actions.title: Take a photo
actions.description: Asks the person to take a photo on the phone.

file.description: Id of a file the device uploaded

actions.title: Scan a document
actions.description: Asks the person to scan a document; returns the file and its text.

file.description: Id of a file the device uploaded

actions.title: Run an iOS Shortcut
actions.description: Runs one of the person's Shortcuts by name.

actions.title: Send an Android intent
actions.description: Starts an app action on Android.

actions.title: Run a shell command
actions.description: Runs a command. Never sent unless shell is turned on for that device.
